ability.text: Once per round: You may evade an enemy at your location. This does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

elder_sign.text: +1. Heal 1 damage and 1 horror from yourself.

signatures.name: Caput Lupinum
signatures.text: Permanent. Fight using <int> instead of <com>. This attack deals +1 damage. If Abraham Setrakian has 3 or fewer health remaining: This attack deals +2 damage instead.

signatures.name: Occido Lumen
signatures.text: Exhaust: Investigate. You get +1 <int>. If successful, discover 1 clue at your location. If you succeed by 2 or more, discover 1 additional clue instead.

signatures.name: Thomas Eichhorst
signatures.text: Cannot be cancelled. Hunter. Prey: Abraham Setrakian only. Forced: When Thomas Eichhorst is defeated: Deal 1 additional damage to Abraham Setrakian.

deck.name: Vasiliy Fet
deck.text: When Abraham Setrakian is dealt damage or horror: Exhaust Vasiliy Fet — deal that much damage to each enemy at Abraham Setrakian's location.

deck.name: Calculated Risk
deck.text: When you fail a skill test: Reveal another chaos token. If successful, pass the test and draw 1 card. If you fail, take 1 additional damage.

deck.name: They Keep Me Alive
deck.text: Spend 1 supply: Heal 1 damage or 1 horror from yourself or an investigator at your location.

deck.name: Crowd Control
deck.text: Deal 1 damage to each enemy at your location. You may move to a connecting location after.

deck.name: Scatter
deck.text: Choose up to 3 enemies at your location. Move each chosen enemy to a connecting location of your choice.

deck.name: Ancient Rites
deck.text: Search the top 8 cards of your deck. Draw up to 3 of them. Shuffle the rest back.

deck.name: Arcane Encyclopaedia
deck.text: Exhaust: You get +2 to any one skill for this test.

deck.name: The Cleansing
deck.text: Deal 1 damage to each enemy in play.

deck.name: Gut Feeling
deck.text: If this test is successful, draw 1 card.

deck.name: Cornered
deck.text: If this test is successful, take 1 damage.

deck.name: Pick Pocket
deck.text: If this test is successful: Return a card from your discard pile to your hand.

deck.name: Survival Instinct
deck.text: When you draw Survival Instinct from your deck: Play it immediately at no cost without using an action. Draw 1 card. Gain 1 resource.
